guardEvidence.howCaught: No new controller: the change only lets the existing usage-limit-session-refresh controller (registered, ratchet-proven) recognise walled sessions on single-login agents. Brakes unchanged: decideLimitRefresh caps restarts at REFRESH_MAX_PER_DAY=3 per conversation per 24 h, REFRESH_BATCH=10 per pass, acts only after a real probe says usage is back. Steady state: at most 3 restarts per conversation per day, then quiet.
